# Viore website Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `.viore/architecture-contract.md` before editing public
technology or product copy. The active public-safe Viore architecture contract
is `2026-07-26.1`.

Distinguish implemented, integration-in-progress, architecture-only and planned
components. Do not describe AlphaImage or AlphaLayer as deployed. Do not expose
provider, model, prompt, routing, token, evaluation or internal security
details.

Prefer Korean communication, surgical changes, existing visual language and
rendered responsive verification.
